note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation) together with the triennial election of aldermen for Duncairn, Ormeau, Pottinger, Smithfield, St Anne's, St George's and Woodvale; nominations Tuesday 5 January, poll Friday 15 January 1932. After two withdrawals 19 of the 22 seats were filled unopposed, and Court, Dock and Shankill were contested (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 7 and 16 January 1932).
